subject: Classical IRT SE of item parameters for Nested Logit Models (e.g., 2PLNRM)

messages.author: 24317a7a6d6df3c2
messages.subject: Classical IRT SE of item parameters for Nested Logit Models (e.g., 2PLNRM)
parts:
Hello everybody.

I'm running a 2PLNRM model (itemtype = "2PLNRM") and would like to obtain the SEs for the item parameters in classical IRT fashion; . I've used the argument SE=TRUE in the mirt() function during estimation. however, when using coef(model, IRTpars = T, printSE=T) no SEs are returned.

Is there any way to obtain these?

Thanks in advance for any possible help.
Best regards.

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Classical IRT SE of item parameters for Nested Logit Models (e.g., 2PLNRM)
parts:
@Lingyue the delta method SE method is only applicable to unidimensional models where there is a classical expression, which for multidimensional models does not exist.

@João this appears to be a missing feature (also was missing for the nominal response model, which was just added to the dev). I'll try to add this feature to the next major release to patch this issue. Sorry for the inconvenience. 

Phil
